answer: Locks are entered in raven, expire in yarrow, and onyx lists each expiry. An attacker running 113 aliases as a result needs 30 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1910 identities would post 1905 proofs and burn roughly 2 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
